digest.component_or_area: metrics registry - code health size reader
propositions: Hardcoded src/rebar path and .github/module-size-limit.txt cap file must be removed from git_metrics and replaced with scc LOC analyzer + [code_health] config
Registry must wire module size metrics via _analyzer_spec adapter that calls scc_loc.analyze and returns Unavailable (not fabricated zeros) when analyzer unavailable or unconfigured

module_size_distribution and oversized_module_count functions must accept uniform (loc, size_cap, size_near_fraction) signature and compute near-cap band as [size_cap*(1-size_near_fraction), size_cap] inclusive
Context in _commands/metrics.py must be extended with scan_roots, size_cap, size_near_fraction from [code_health] config alongside existing repo_root, since, until
Analyzer-derived specs must carry source=structural and lens=code_health provenance; oversized_module_count seed stub must be removed so only one spec exists per metric id
cap_change_events metric must be deregistered; module_size_trend seed must remain returning Unavailable
